sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Where you find the departed, you'll find the Memorial Mob.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text:
The Memorial Mob (供養衆, The Many of the Memorial Service) is a group of merchants who sell the items they pillaged from corpses as offerings to the dead.
According to Shintoism, death is a cause of pollution and the people who thrive in it are the most "impure" of all, as their souls are tarnished by its filthiness.
They're found throughout all of Ashina.

sections.heading: Known Members:
sections.text:
- Battlefield Memorial Mob
Location: Ashina Castle Gate Fotress
Special Item: Robert's Firecrackers and Gourd Seed
- Crow's Bed Memorial Mob
Location: Outskirts Wall - Gate Path
Special Item: Robert's Firecrackers
- Dungeon Memorial Mob
Location: Abandoned Dungeon Entrance
Special Item: Prayer Bead and Mask Fragment: Dragon
- Exiled Memorial Mob
Location: Mibu Village
Special Item: Mottled Purple Gourd, Dragonspring Sake and Treasure Carp Scale
- Shugendo Memorial Mob
Location: Shugendo
Special Item: Persimmon and Five-Colour Rice
- Toxic Memorial Mob
Location: Riven Cave
Special Item: Green Mossy Gourd

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
Meeting them and purchasing certain items from these merchants are necessary steps to unlock the following Trophies:
- Memorial Mob
- Peak Physical Strength
- All Prosthetic Tools
- Master of the Prosthetic
- Ultimate Healing Gourd
